newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: POLL - Portugal seen keeping rates steady tomorrow.
newsitem.headline: POLL - Portugal seen keeping rates steady tomorrow.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal was expected to leave key rates steady tomorrow and to wait for June inflation data before reconsidering rates, according to nine out of 10 analysts with brokers and banks polled by Reuters.
They said the market was not discounting a drop in Portuguese rates and that the central bank would cut rates again only if the June data confirmed a continuing fall in inflation.
The Bank of Portugal will announce its decision on rates tomorrow at the start of a new commercial bank reserve period.
The repo rate presently stands at 6.00 percent, the draining rate at 5.70 percent and the emergency rate at 7.70 percent.
The following are the results of the poll, conducted today.
1. Will the Bank of Portugal lower the repo rate this week?
No - 9
Yes - 1
2. If the answer to question 1. is yes, by how much will the Bank of Portugal lower the repo rate?
25 basis points
3. Will the Bank of Portugal lower the draining rate this week?
No - 9
Yes - 1
4. If the answer to question 3. is yes, by how much will the Bank of Portugal lower the draining rate?
25 basis points
5. Is there room for further cuts in key rates?
Yes - 10
No - 0

NOTE: Banks and brokers which took part in the poll included: Banco Portugues de Investimento; IMF-Informacao de Mercados Financeiros; Siemca-Sociedade Mediadora de Capitais; Fincor; Credit Lyonnais; Banco de Comercio e Industria; Banco Finantia; Banco Mello de Investimentos.
-- Fernanda Pargana, Lisbon newsroom +351-1-3538254
